title: Floods: Number of evacuees in three states unchanged | The Star
text:
Floods: Number of evacuees in three states unchanged | The Star
KUALA LUMPUR: The number of flood evacuees in Perak, Sabah and Sarawak on Monday (Sept 25) morning remained unchanged since last night at 274 people, currently housed at three temporary relief centres.
In PERAK, the state Disaster Management Committee (JPBN) Secretariat said that 38 people from nine families from Kampung Matang Tengah in Kerian district were housed at the SK Changkat Lobak relief centre as of 9am.
